title: median returns wrong result for multi-digit numbers
body:
## Problem

`median` in `median.js` sorts without a numeric comparator, so multi-digit numbers come out in string order.

Failing example: `median([10, 2, 30])` returns `2`, want `10`.

## Done when

- `median([10, 2, 30])` is `10`
- `node check.js` passes
